Checks (1) and (3) are declared defensive with forgery witnesses (a forged module witness is the only way to vary a witness scalar under a matching journal root) and check (4) is declared producer-drift protection with a drifted-producer witness (F3, F4); the producer pass-through is exercised for three codes. Earlier: Candidate C9a: receipt admission for the ASSET_TRANSFER allocation fragment. verify_asset_transfer_fragment_receipt_v1 admits a fragment only through the receipt-verified module witness (VerifiedLaneModuleTransitionV1, mintable only by verify_asset_transfer_lane_module_receipt_v1 after a succinct-receipt check against the recomputed module journal under an ACTIVE_NEW release image): one journal-root equality binds the caller's accepted value to the proof, statement-root and command-occurrence checks double-bind defensively, the wave-B producer re-runs with its full closed check family, the produced binding_root must equal the witness-bound receipt root, and the result is the token-gated immutable VerifiedLaneAllocationFragmentV1. Closed five-code ReceiptWitnessRejectCodeV1 family plus untouched producer pass-through; every reject is a value. The accept-path test mints a REAL witness through the ABI fixture chain (no forgery on the accept path); the certificate registry still keeps ASSET_TRANSFER at NO_PRODUCER, so no acceptance path consumes this witness until C9b lands the registry flip behind a type gate. Research-only; grants no authority.
